starting_state: Prepared clear 50 mL thiosulphate aliquot in a nominal 100 mL beaker over a visible cross; values are source-plan facts, not image measurements.
scope: Visual excerpt after source step 1. Source step 2 is split into delivery and swirling. Timing half-way through transfer must be measured in a real experiment; generated clip duration is not a rate measurement. The short observation need not reach complete cross disappearance. This independent trial uses source variant hcl_4ml, not a top-up of any previous run.

clips.name: acid_delivery
clips.action: Deliver the source-defined 4 mL of 1 M hydrochloric acid into the existing fresh beaker aliquot, then stop delivery.
clips.state_before: Clear aliquot; the cross below is visible.
clips.state_after: Only the delivered dose increases the level; sulphur clouding may begin gradually.

clips.name: swirl
clips.action: Gently swirl the existing beaker once while keeping all liquid inside; add no further reagent.
clips.state_before: The same just-dosed sample from the preceding frame.
clips.state_after: The same sample becomes evenly mixed; no extra dose or sudden emptying.

clips.name: observe_cross
clips.action: Hold the camera and beaker stationary and observe the source-described gradual turbidity.
clips.state_before: The mixed sample after acid addition; retain the preceding meniscus and cross position.
clips.state_after: Visibility of the cross gradually decreases if the source reaction progresses; do not force the endpoint within two seconds or invent a measured time.

reuse_rationale: Identical visible pre-acid state: fresh 50 mL 0.1 M clear thiosulphate in the same 100 mL beaker geometry above a visible cross. Acid dose differs only after this image. This is a fresh independent trial, not the previous trial continued. Image does not verify concentration, volume or temperature.
